_note: DEMO DATA — fictional FAQ for the fictional demo shop 'BrightHome Goods'.

faqs.answer: We ship within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days and costs 3.90 EUR; orders over 50 EUR ship free. Express delivery (1-2 business days) costs 7.90 EUR.
faqs.question: How long does shipping take and what does it cost?

faqs.answer: You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Start your return from your account page under 'My orders', print the label, and drop the parcel off. Refunds are issued within 5 business days after we receive the item.
faqs.question: What is your return policy?

faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Klarna, and Apple Pay. All payments are processed over encrypted connections; we never see or store your full card number.
faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?

faqs.answer: Yes! You can track your parcel any time with the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email, or ask me here with your order number (for example: 'Where is my order #1042?').
faqs.question: How can I track my order?

faqs.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00 (CET), at support@brighthome-goods.example. Average reply time is under 4 business hours.
faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?

faqs.answer: If an item arrives damaged or faulty, send us a photo within 14 days and we'll ship a free replacement or refund you — your choice. You don't need to return the damaged item.
faqs.question: What if my item arrives damaged?

faqs.answer: Create a free account and tick 'loyalty program' during signup. You earn 1 point per euro spent; 100 points give you a 5 EUR voucher. Points never expire.
faqs.question: Do you have a loyalty or discount program?

faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to all EU countries. Shipping times are 3-7 business days and costs are calculated at checkout based on the destination country.
faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
